events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair took place over three days in 1969, becoming a pivotal moment in music history.

angles.name: Remembering Woodstock
angles.copy: 57 years since the legendary Woodstock Festival. What was your favourite performance from the original lineup?

events.title: Elvis Presley's Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: The music world remembers Elvis Presley, who passed away on this day in 1977.

angles.name: King of Rock and Roll Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, today. His legacy continues to inspire generations.

events.title: Tupac Shakur's Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: The music world remembers influential rapper Tupac Shakur, who was shot in Las Vegas in 1996.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the profound impact of Tupac Shakur on music and culture. His words still resonate.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: The music world remembers guitar legend Jimi Hendrix, who passed away on this day in 1970.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Guitar God
angles.copy: Celebrating the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix. His guitar work changed music forever.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Iconic Album
angles.copy: 57 years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is still one of the most famous of all time.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' iconic frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie Hynde
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman and solo artist Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam Gallagher
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! What's your favourite Oasis or solo track?

events.title: John Lennon's Imagine Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic song "Imagine" was released as a single in the UK in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine 51 Years On
angles.copy: 51 years since John Lennon released 'Imagine'. A song that still resonates with its powerful message of peace and unity.

events.title: First iPod Release Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first generation iPod in 2001, revolutionising portable music listening.

angles.name: Remembering the iPod
angles.copy: 25 years ago, the iPod changed how we listened to music forever. Who still has their original?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day celebrates the anniversary of the first Bond film, Dr. No, which premiered in 1962.

angles.name: Happy James Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! What's your favourite 007 film or theme song? Licence to thrill!

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the incredible life and music of John Lennon.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 87th Birthday to the iconic John Cleese! What's your favourite Monty Python sketch or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: The Beatles' White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles' 'White Album' dropped. A masterpiece of diverse sounds and songwriting.

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: The music world remembers Queen's iconic frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie Mercury
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: 61 years since The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul'. An album that pushed boundaries and influenced generations.
